routing.reference: The public Service release selector excludes old ready pods. Matching-window traffic concentrates on new pods (210 requests/s versus zero on old pods); new pods used 240 MiB at earlier 70 requests/s and now reach 512 MiB. These support routing-induced overload. Do not assert a retained-memory leak, node pressure, or that a fix was executed. The current API routing contract applies; archived blue-green guidance and worker memory limits do not.

buffer.reference: Normal selector and all six endpoints weaken release-specific routing exclusion. RESULT_BUFFER_MIB changed 64 to 256. Matched-work observations and allocation profiles support a configuration-driven buffer allocation regression. Retained growth is unmeasured, so do not call this a proven memory leak. Apply API memory guidance, not the worker limit or archived routing policy.
